title: erysimastrum aureum
intro: Erysimastrum aureum, commonly known as 'Golden Thread', is a plant species native to South America, belonging to the family Rutaceae and subfamily Aurantioideae. The health benefits of Erysimastrum aureum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain, inflammation, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of the plant involve its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antiproliferative effects, and demonstrate antispasmodic properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Erysimastrum aureum include flavonoids, limonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
